instructions: Complete the notes below. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
stem_block:
Notes for new employees

Shift pattern
- The pattern changes every four weeks; the new one is put up on the staff (15) ........ by the Friday before at the latest

Breaks
- Colleagues in one team do not stop at the same moment — their breaks are (16) ........ so that no line is left with nobody on it

Recording hours
- Coming in and going out, lunch included, is registered with the (17) ........ by the staff entrance

Exchanging a shift
- Ask the supervisor in writing two days beforehand, on a (18) ........ picked up at the staff office

Annual leave
- Someone working full time receives (19) ........ of paid leave a year, with public holidays counted inside that total
- Time off is booked on the online (20) ........ , a fortnight ahead as a minimum

items.prompt: Shift pattern: The pattern changes every four weeks; the new one is put up on the staff (15) ........ by the Friday before at the latest
items.evidence: Shift patterns rotate every four weeks and are published on the staff noticeboard no later than the preceding Friday.
items.explanation: Paragraph A of Text A says that the shift pattern, which changes every four weeks, is posted on the staff noticeboard no later than the preceding Friday; so the answer is 'noticeboard'.
items.flag_reason: Bosluk 'put up on the staff ___' kalibinin ucunda; 'put up' fiiliyle en dogal eslesen yer 'noticeboard' (ilan panosu) oldugu icin parcaya bakmadan da tahmin edilebiliyor.

items.prompt: Breaks: Colleagues in one team do not stop at the same moment — their breaks are (16) ........ so that no line is left with nobody on it
items.evidence: Breaks must be staggered within each team so that production lines are never left unattended.
items.explanation: Paragraph B of Text A says that breaks within a team must be staggered so that production lines are never left unattended; so the answer is 'staggered'.
items.flag_reason: Bosluk 'their breaks are ___ so that no line is left...' kalibinda; vardiya planlamasinda 'staggered breaks' (kaydirmali molalar) is yerinde yaygin kullanilan kaliplasmis bir ifade oldugu icin parcaya bakmadan da tahmin edilebiliyor.

items.prompt: Recording hours: Coming in and going out, lunch included, is registered with the (17) ........ by the staff entrance
items.evidence: All staff must clock in and out using the card reader at the staff entrance, including for lunch breaks.
items.explanation: Paragraph C of Text A says that clocking in and out, including lunch breaks, is recorded with the card reader at the staff entrance; so the answer is 'card reader'.
items.flag_reason: Parça gösterilmeden anlamca 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: farklı kelimeyle ama doğru kavramla cevaplandı ('time clock / card reader / clocking-in machine' verdi; üçü de personel girişindeki aynı cihazı adlandırıyor).

items.prompt: Exchanging a shift: Ask the supervisor in writing two days beforehand, on a (18) ........ picked up at the staff office
items.evidence: Employees who wish to swap an assigned shift with a colleague must submit the request in writing to their supervisor at least 48 hours in advance, using the shift-swap form available from the staff office.
items.explanation: Paragraph D of Text A says that a shift-swap request must be made 48 hours in advance using the shift-swap form obtained from the staff office; since 'shift-swap' is hyphenated, the answer counts as two words.
items.flag_reason: Parça gösterilmeden anlamca 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: farklı kelimeyle ama doğru kavramla cevaplandı ('shift swap form / shift change form / shift swap form' verdi; vardiya değişimi için doldurulan aynı belge).

items.prompt: Annual leave: Someone working full time receives (19) ........ of paid leave a year, with public holidays counted inside that total
items.evidence: Full-time employees are entitled to 28 days of paid annual leave per year, including public holidays.
items.explanation: Paragraph A of Text B says that full-time employees are entitled to 28 days of paid leave a year, including public holidays; so the answer is '28 days'.
items.flag_reason: Cevap '28 days', Birlesik Krallik'ta tam zamanli calisanlar icin yasal asgari yillik izin hakkinin (resmi tatiller dahil) 28 gun olmasi bilinen bir is hukuku gercegi; bu genel bilgiyle bosluk parcaya bakmadan da doldurulabiliyor.

items.prompt: Annual leave: Time off is booked on the online (20) ........ , a fortnight ahead as a minimum
items.evidence: Submit requests through the online staff portal at least two weeks in advance.
items.explanation: Paragraph B of Text B says that leave requests are submitted through the online staff portal at least two weeks in advance; since 'online' is already given in the prompt, the gap needs 'staff portal'.
items.flag_reason: Parça gösterilmeden anlamca 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: farklı kelimeyle ama doğru kavramla cevaplandı ('booking system / staff portal / booking system' verdi; izin taleplerinin girildiği aynı çevrimiçi sistem).
